page.overview:
Who is Alec Holland?

Constantine agreed, deputing Ravager and Red Hood to take the survivors to Ivy's jungle, while telling the others to come with him. Swamp Thing took the Shadowpact members to a bunker, which was surrounded by hellfire, the Anti-Living and an apparent blood moat. As Zatanna casted a spell to help them fly to the bunker, the infected Plastic Man quickly pounced on them. Ragman was soon killed and Blue Devil was killed while rescuing Zatanna.

Swamp Thing protected the surviving members from being swallowed by Plastic Man, by enveloping them in a giant ball made of plants. After Zatanna recovered, Bobo and Constantine had her cast Plastic Man into the hellfire. As they mourned their losses, Constantine told them that they should get out of there quick, since they were surrounded by the undead. The alert Bobo quickly noticed mounted machine guns coming out of the bunker and told everyone to get down. As the machine guns fired at the Anti-Living, Swamp Thing remained standing, since he could easily regenerate his body or create a new one. The Penguin told them on the loudspeaker that they could come in or die outside.

Inside the bunker, they learnt how many of the rich survivors had gathered there, while making the less affluent ones work for them in return for shelter. Alec, accompanied by Zatanna and Detective Chimp, soon came upon the Floronic Man who was being tortured and experimented upon for producing food. Alec lashed out in anger, leading to the bunker's guards battling with him and Shadowpact. Max Lord was killed by Swamp Thing after refusing to do what he told him. Constantine teleported the Shadowpact and Alec to Gotham after they were outnumbered by Amazo androids created by Professor Ivo. Alec protested, but Constantine stated that they needed a plan to battle them.
